title: USGS ShakeMap of the Kaikōura earthquake, 2016
altText: USGS colour-coded shaking intensity map of the 2016 Kaikōura earthquake.
caption: USGS ShakeMap showing the estimated shaking intensity associated with the November 2016 Kaikōura earthquake, in a later revised edition.
dateDisplay: 13 November 2016 (event; map subsequently revised to April 2017)
context: This image was revised after the earthquake; use the version date recorded with its source rather than describing it as the first operational map.
